title: InviteLinkAcceptedData
description: data of invite_link.accepted (registry 1.6.0, ADR-0046, PE-39). A signed-in person redeemed a team invite link and joined its team. tilo-api writes it after the link was claimed and the membership written, never an agent or a model: actor and target are the person who joined, the world is that person's Desk world (PE-12), district is null and vis is [] (owner-only, ADR-0009). Ids only: never the token, nonce, an address or a name. A membership is not a send, so it is not a side effect and authz is null.
